onboardingEvidence.provenance: The official careers page links directly to this board. Browser inspection on 2026-09-02 showed 13 total jobs and all 13 listing cards.
onboardingEvidence.platform: Talemetry careersites (ttcportals), with Jobvite application widget
onboardingEvidence.listingEvidence: GET /search/jobs renders HTML with .jobs-section__item cards. The live frontend advertises GET /search/jobs.json in CareerSite.Path.configure; direct requests returned 403, so no JSON response schema is claimed. The HTML next link is /search/jobs?page=2; actual multi-page behavior remains unproven because this board currently has only 13 rows.
onboardingEvidence.detailEvidence: The public job page contains the full Synaptics description, including ASIC new-product introduction and production test responsibilities. No JobPosting JSON-LD was present. Generic static-css does not fetch these separate descriptions.
onboardingEvidence.transportEvidence: Direct Node fetches of the listing, JSON path, page 2, job detail and robots.txt returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare Just a moment challenge. The same HTML listing and detail were readable in the normal browser; this is not a claim that the board is inaccessible.
onboardingEvidence.robots: https://careers.synaptics.com/robots.txt returned HTTP 403; directives could not be read.
onboardingEvidence.headquartersEvidence: The official contact page identifies headquarters at 1109 McKay Dr., San Jose, California, USA.
onboardingEvidence.notes: Diagnostic candidate only, not ready for admission. A shared reader must provide reliable listing transport, published-total reconciliation, terminal pagination, and deferred HTML descriptions before full proof can pass. No shared code was changed.
